```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/05_vacuum_oscillations/three_flavor_triangle.css">

<div class="three-flavor-triangle" data-three-flavor-triangle>
  <div class="three-flavor-triangle__controls">
    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__control">
      <span class="three-flavor-triangle__label">Начальный флэйвор</span>
      <div class="three-flavor-triangle__buttons" role="group" aria-label="Начальный флэйвор">
        <button type="button" data-source="0">ν<sub>e</sub></button>
        <button type="button" data-source="1" class="is-active">ν<sub>μ</sub></button>
        <button type="button" data-source="2">ν<sub>τ</sub></button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__control">
      <span class="three-flavor-triangle__label">Частица</span>
      <div class="three-flavor-triangle__buttons" role="group" aria-label="Нейтрино или антинейтрино">
        <button type="button" data-antineutrino="false" class="is-active">ν</button>
        <button type="button" data-antineutrino="true">ν̄</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__control">
      <label><span>Энергия <i>E</i></span><output data-energy-output>0.60 ГэВ</output></label>
      <input type="range" min="0.20" max="5.00" step="0.05" value="0.60"
             data-energy-input aria-label="Энергия нейтрино в ГэВ">
    </div>

    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__control">
      <label><span>Путь <i>L</i></span><output data-baseline-output>295 км</output></label>
      <input type="range" min="0" max="1300" step="5" value="295"
             data-baseline-input aria-label="Путь нейтрино в километрах">
    </div>

    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__control">
      <label><span>Фаза <i>δ</i><sub>CP</sub></span><output data-delta-output>212°</output></label>
      <input type="range" min="0" max="360" step="1" value="212"
             data-delta-input aria-label="CP-фаза в градусах">
    </div>

    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__readout">
      <span><i>L/E</i></span><strong data-ratio-output>492 км/ГэВ</strong>
    </div>

    <div class="three-flavor-triangle__transport">
      <button type="button" data-play>▶ Пустить</button>
      <button type="button" data-reset>↺ В начало</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="three-flavor-triangle__visual">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 760 430" role="img"
         aria-label="Треугольник вероятностей электронного, мюонного и тау-флэйворов">
      <g class="three-flavor-triangle__grid" aria-hidden="true">
        <path d="M380 42 L100 288 L660 288 Z"></path>
        <path d="M310 103.5 L450 103.5"></path>
        <path d="M240 165 L520 165"></path>
        <path d="M170 226.5 L590 226.5"></path>
        <path d="M310 103.5 L520 288"></path>
        <path d="M240 165 L380 288"></path>
        <path d="M170 226.5 L240 288"></path>
        <path d="M450 103.5 L240 288"></path>
        <path d="M520 165 L380 288"></path>
        <path d="M590 226.5 L520 288"></path>
      </g>

      <path class="three-flavor-triangle__trail" data-trail></path>
      <circle class="three-flavor-triangle__halo" data-halo r="18"></circle>
      <circle class="three-flavor-triangle__point" data-point r="8"></circle>

      <text class="three-flavor-triangle__vertex three-flavor-triangle__vertex--e"
            x="380" y="27" text-anchor="middle">P<tspan baseline-shift="sub">e</tspan> = 1</text>
      <text class="three-flavor-triangle__vertex three-flavor-triangle__vertex--mu"
            x="92" y="316" text-anchor="end">P<tspan baseline-shift="sub">μ</tspan> = 1</text>
      <text class="three-flavor-triangle__vertex three-flavor-triangle__vertex--tau"
            x="668" y="316" text-anchor="start">P<tspan baseline-shift="sub">τ</tspan> = 1</text>

      <g class="three-flavor-triangle__bar-labels">
        <text x="120" y="344" class="three-flavor-triangle__value--e">Pₑ</text>
        <text x="120" y="369" class="three-flavor-triangle__value--mu">Pμ</text>
        <text x="120" y="394" class="three-flavor-triangle__value--tau">Pτ</text>
      </g>

      <g class="three-flavor-triangle__bars" transform="translate(150 330)">
        <g transform="translate(0 0)">
          <rect class="three-flavor-triangle__bar-bg" width="460" height="16" rx="8"></rect>
          <rect class="three-flavor-triangle__bar three-flavor-triangle__bar--e"
                data-bar="0" width="0" height="16" rx="8"></rect>
        </g>
        <g transform="translate(0 25)">
          <rect class="three-flavor-triangle__bar-bg" width="460" height="16" rx="8"></rect>
          <rect class="three-flavor-triangle__bar three-flavor-triangle__bar--mu"
                data-bar="1" width="0" height="16" rx="8"></rect>
        </g>
        <g transform="translate(0 50)">
          <rect class="three-flavor-triangle__bar-bg" width="460" height="16" rx="8"></rect>
          <rect class="three-flavor-triangle__bar three-flavor-triangle__bar--tau"
                data-bar="2" width="0" height="16" rx="8"></rect>
        </g>
      </g>

      <g class="three-flavor-triangle__values">
        <text x="620" y="344" class="three-flavor-triangle__value--e" data-probability="0">0.000</text>
        <text x="620" y="369" class="three-flavor-triangle__value--mu" data-probability="1">1.000</text>
        <text x="620" y="394" class="three-flavor-triangle__value--tau" data-probability="2">0.000</text>
      </g>
      <text class="three-flavor-triangle__status" x="380" y="418" text-anchor="middle"
            data-status>νμ → (e, μ, τ)</text>
    </svg>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="assets/05_vacuum_oscillations/three_flavor_triangle.js"></script>
```
